description: Generates cinematic AI motion for one shot (moving water, fire, people, trees). The camera on an AI+ shot is one gentle push-in, so there is no camera move to pick or describe; the prompt names what should move in the scene. Uses 1 AI+ credit once approved. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".

prompt.description: What should move in the scene, like 'water ripples in the pool'.

name: request_ai_plus
title: AI+ motion
